plan.approach: Fix the handling of Attribute nodes whose `.value` points to a constant/literal address so they properly lower into an address type instead of hitting the generic-fallback route that ends up raising TypeCheckFailure.
plan.hypothesis: When an AddressHexLIT node representing a hexadecimal literal address access balance is processed in expr.py's parse_value_expr method, neither cls nor parent.get("balance") handles the case correctly before reaching the final fallback expression handler inside parse_value_expr.
